lines.trans: Max, the dining hall is full of people again.
Yes, our evening ended very successfully.
Still, changes always happen unexpectedly.
You are right, life constantly changes around us.
Sometimes we get something completely different.

words.gloss: to receive, to get; to earn

lines.trans: We get not what we wanted before.

words.gloss: to receive, to get; to earn

lines.trans: But often everything turns out even better.

words.gloss: to turn out, develop, take shape

lines.trans: Sometimes we realize that we were right.
And our old friends remain by our side.
And sometimes we arrive back at the starting point.

words.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

lines.trans: The main thing is not to lose faith and hope.
The main thing is to believe in all changes.
All changes in life lead to the better!

words.gloss: to lead, to conduct (вести себя = to behave)

бывать.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

meanings.en: to happen, to exist, there can be
meanings.note: 3rd person бывает = there is / can be

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
The main thing is not to lose faith.

вести.gloss: to lead, to conduct (вести себя = to behave)

meanings.en: to lead, to guide, to drive
вести себя: to behave, to conduct oneself
meanings.note: Вы как маленькая себя ведёте = You're behaving like a little girl

examples.trans: You're behaving like a little girl.
She was running after me (around me).

meanings.en: after all, still, all the same

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: the thing that ends is the subject
деньги закончились = the money ran out

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.en: sometimes, from time to time, occasionally

examples.trans: Sometimes a person makes astonishing discoveries.
We returned to the starting point.
There's someone here to see you.

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Это неожиданно, но ваш торт не такой плохой.
examples.trans: This is unexpected, but your cake isn't so bad.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: остаётся у нас = stays with us

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: Все перемены в нашей жизни к лучшему.
examples.trans: All changes in our life are for the better.

examples.text: На столе стоял полный стакан воды.
examples.trans: A full glass of water stood on the table.

получать.gloss: to receive, to get; to earn

meanings.en: at times, sometimes, now and then

examples.text: Порой мы убеждаемся в своей правоте.
examples.trans: Sometimes we realize we were right.
What are you constantly afraid of?
He was constantly late for work.

meanings.note: short form: ты прав = you're right
regularly, or as a general invitation: приходи!

meanings.en: to happen, take place, go on
meanings.note: Что происходит? = What is going on?

examples.trans: What is going on? I don't understand.

examples.text: В моей комнате раньше дядя Миша жил.
examples.trans: Uncle Misha used to live in my room.
There used to be an old park here.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.
A plot next to Grigory Soprykin.

складываться.gloss: to turn out, develop, take shape

meanings.en: to take shape, turn out, form

examples.text: Всё складывается даже лучше наших планов.
examples.trans: Everything is turning out even better than our plans.

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.
We arrived at the starting point.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)
to become convinced, make sure, realize

examples.text: Мы убеждаемся в этом каждый день.
examples.trans: We become convinced of this every day.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.

examples.text: О, это, Аркашенька, бывает очень часто.
examples.trans: Oh, that happens very often, Arkashenka.
We often meet in the park.
There are a lot of people here.
